prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 电子发票常见问题 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 3 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "问题" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 291px
  col 2: header "回答" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 1440px
  col 3: header "相关链接" · longest unbreakable word 198px · one-line width 214px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"解答电子发票的法律效力、换票、真伪查验、重复报销和保存等常见问题，并提供相关链接。","reading":"读者先扫描首列问题定位主题，再横向阅读对应回答和链接；每行需要保持清晰的关联。","groups":["问题列与回答列构成问答对，读者主要在这两列之间横向阅读。","相关链接列为对应行提供延伸或查验入口，应与该行问答保持关联。"],"keep_intact":["相关链接中的长网址或标识符需要足够宽度，避免在不可断开内容处溢出。","问题中的关键词和回答中的发票号码、日期等信息应保持可辨认。"],"may_wrap":["问题和回答均为中文自然语言，可在合适位置换行。","回答通常较长，会形成多行；同一行的高度可容纳问题和链接的适度换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [200, 300, 219] · table 720×836px · row heights [36, 129, 129, 129, 129, 153, 129] · column headers wrapped 0/3 · tallest cell 6 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [260, 240, 219] · table 720×1022px · row heights [36, 176, 153, 153, 176, 176, 153] · column headers wrapped 0/3 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [160, 340, 219] · table 720×813px · row heights [36, 129, 129, 129, 129, 129, 129] · column headers wrapped 0/3 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"问题多为两行，便于逐行定位；回答与链接的对应关系清楚，表头和长链接均未溢出。","problems":"回答较密，重复报销一行比其他行更高；部分问题的词组在行尾被拆开，链接列下方也有较多空白。","cause":"200px的问题列占去了一部分回答空间，300px的回答列使最长回答达到六行；219px的链接列虽容纳最长不可断开片段，但短链接无法填满列宽。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"问题列较宽，部分问题可一行读完或只需两行，扫描入口醒目；链接完整且表头清晰。","problems":"回答被挤成狭长段落，行高明显增加，问题和链接下方出现大块空白，横向关联也因长行距而较难持续追踪。","cause":"260px的问题列对较短问题分配过多宽度，240px的回答列无法匹配长篇回答的内容量。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"340px的回答列改善了长文本的阅读节奏，六个数据行等高，问答与链接的横向对应清晰；链接未发生不可断开内容溢出。","problems":"160px的问题列使较长问题达到三行，首行末尾的“吗？”以及第三个问题末尾的“效？”显得零碎；部分回答末尾也只剩一两个字。","cause":"问题列可用文本宽度仅139px，长问题在不理想的位置换行；340px的回答列虽较宽，但个别回答仍恰好在行尾产生短尾。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced","widths":[180,320,219],"change":"在r0C基础上给问题列增加20px，争取减少问题中的零碎尾行，同时保留较宽的回答列和完整链接。"},{"name":"answer-first","widths":[145,355,219],"change":"进一步增加回答宽度，测试能否减少回答短尾及行高；观察更窄的问题列是否仍适合扫描。"},{"name":"question-first","widths":[190,310,219],"change":"在r0A与r0C之间测试更宽的问题列，寻找问题换行和回答密度之间的折中。"}]}
